name: glint-md
description: Static Markdown wiki and self-contained HTML renderer

scripts.stage:spa: rm -rf dist-spa && mkdir dist-spa && cp src/spa/index.html src/spa/embed-host.html src/spa/config.js src/spa/manifest.webmanifest src/spa/privacy.html src/spa/terms.html src/spa/CNAME dist-spa/ && cp skills/glint-markdown/SKILL.md dist-spa/llm.txt && cp -R assets dist-spa/assets
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run stage:spa && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory dist-spa
scripts.bundle:vendor: rm -rf assets/fonts assets/katex assets/fonts.css assets/mermaid.min.js && mkdir assets/katex && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css assets/katex/ && cp -R node_modules/katex/dist/fonts assets/katex/fonts && esbuild src/spa/fonts.css --bundle --minify --outfile=assets/fonts.css --loader:.woff=file --loader:.woff2=file --asset-names=fonts/[name] && esbuild src/vendor/mermaid.ts --bundle --minify --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=assets/mermaid.min.js
scripts.bundle:tikz: rm -rf assets/tikzjax && mkdir -p assets/tikzjax && cp node_modules/@planktimerr/tikzjax/dist/tikzjax.js node_modules/@planktimerr/tikzjax/dist/run-tex.js node_modules/@planktimerr/tikzjax/dist/core.dump.gz node_modules/@planktimerr/tikzjax/dist/tex.wasm.gz node_modules/@planktimerr/tikzjax/dist/fonts.css assets/tikzjax/ && cp -R node_modules/@planktimerr/tikzjax/dist/fonts node_modules/@planktimerr/tikzjax/dist/tex_files assets/tikzjax/
scripts.bundle: rm -f assets/*.bundle.js && npm run bundle:vendor && npm run bundle:tikz && npm run bundle:editor && npm run bundle:render && npm run bundle:spa

author: Jarred Barber
